deadline.value: January 1 priority application deadline for Fall entry term
deadline.quote: January 1 - Priority Application Deadline for Fall entry term

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required but highly recommended for assistantship consideration.
gre_general.quote: Not required but highly recommended. Providing GRE scores will greatly increase student's chance in receiving a graduate assistantship

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Atmospheric and Earth Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: Full-time assistantship typically covers full tuition benefits, health insurance, a stipend, and fees.
funding.quote: A full-time (9-12 enrolled hours) assistantship (20 hours/week) typically covers full tuition benefits, full health insurance (single person), a stipend, and associated fees.

entry_route.value: Unconditional admission requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent with minimum 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: To qualify for unconditional admission to the UAH Graduate School, you must hold a bachelor's degree, or equivalent, from an approved institution and have a minimum 3.0 GPA on your undergraduate record.
